spans.s:
m. (-रः)
A hog.
E.
कॄ to scatter, क affix; also किरि.

m. (-रः)
1 A parrot.
2 Kashmir.
m. plu. (-राः)
The people of Kashmir.
n. (-रं)
Flesh.
E.
की bad, vile, ईर to send or order, क aff.

m. (-कः)
A scribe.
E.
कॄ to scatter, वुन् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A tree.
2 A

Buddha.
3

Obtaining, gaining.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-णः)
1 A ray of light, a sun or moon beam.
2 The sun.
E.
क to scatter, (light,) and क्यु Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Radiant, bright, refulgent.
E.
किरण and मयट् aff.

m. (-ली)
The sun.
E.
किरण, माला a garland, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्)
1 Scattering, spreading.
2 Lighting, shedding light.
E.
कॄ to scatter, शतृ aff.

m. (-तः)
1 A savage, one of the barbarous tribes who inhabit woods and mountains and live by the chase, the Kirrhadoe of

Arrian.
2
ŚIVA as a mountaineer opposed to ARJUNA, the account of which is the subject of the poem, the

Kirātārjunīya.
3

A kind of gentian: see किराततिक्त.
4 A pigmy, a dwarf.
5 A groom, a horseman.
f. (-ती)
1 The river GAṄGES or its goddess.
2 A name of

DURGĀ.
3

A bawd, a procuress.
4 The celestial GAṄGES or river of Svarga.
E.
कॄ to scatter, (speech, &c.) and अत who goes; also किरातक.

m. (-क्तः)
A kind of gentian, (Gentiana cherayta.)
E.
किरात a savage, तिक्त pungent, bitter.

m. (-शी)
A name of GARUḌA the bird of VIṢṆU.
E.
किरात a pigmy, and अशिन् who eats.

f. (-तिः)
A name of the GAṄGES.
E.
कॄ to scatter, (sound, &c.) to make a murmuring noise, अत who goes, and इन् aff.

f. (-नी)
Indian spikenard; see जटामांसी.

m. (-रिः)
A hog.
E.
कॄ to scatter, (dirt, &c.) and इ Uṇādi aff.

n. (-टिः)
The fruit of the marshy date tree.

mn. (-टः-टं)
A crest, a diadem.
E.
कॄ to scatter, (pearls, &c.) and कीटन् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-णं)
Wearing a tiara, assuming the crown.
E.
किरीट, and धारण bearing.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Crowned, having a tiara.
m. (-री)
A king.
E.
किरीट, and धारिन् who wears.

mfn. (-टी-टिनी-टि)
Crested, crowned.
m. (-टी)
1 A king.
9 A name of ARJUNA.
E.
किरीट a crest, and इनि aff.

f. (-र्म्मी)
The Palāśa tree: see पलाश.
2 A hall, a building, an apartment.
3 An image of gold.
4 A figure of iron.
E.
कृ to make, मन् and ङीप् affix, deriv. irr.

f. (-र्म्मी)
A house for straw; also हेमपुत्री.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Variegated.
m. (-रः)
1 The orange tree.
2 The name of a Rākṣasa or goblin.
3 A variegated colour.
E.
कॄ to scatter, ईरन् affix; and मुट् inserted.

m. (-जित्)
A name of BHĪMASENA one of the Pāṇḍu princes.
E.
किर्म्मीर a demon, and जित् who conquers.

f. (-त्वक्)
The orange tree.
E.
किर्म्मीर variegated, and त्वच् bark.

m. (-भित् or -भिद्)
A name of BHĪMA: see किर्म्मीरजित्.

m. (-नः)
A name of BHĪMA: see the preceding.

m. (-ष्टः)
1 A tree, a species of mountain Pīlu: see अक्षोड.
2 The mango tree.
E.
कीर a parrot, and इष्ट wished, desired.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Covered, secreted, hidden.
2 Scattered, thrown, cast.
3 Injured, hurt.
4 Full.
E.
कॄ to scatter, affix क्त, formation irr.

f. (-र्णिः)
1 Scattering, throwing.
2 Covering, concealing.
E.
कॄ to scatter, क्तिन् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Saying, telling.
2

Repeating.
3

Celebrating, praising.
f. (-ना)
Fame, glory.
E.
कृत to praise or celebrate, युच् aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Praising, celebrating.
E.
कृत to praise, शतृ aff.

f. (-र्त्तिः)
1 Fame, renown, glory.
2 Favour, approbation.
3

Sound.
4

Light, lustre.
5 Mud, dirt.
6 Diffusing, expansion.
7 One of the Mātṛkās or personified divine energies of KṚṢṆA.
E.
कृत to celebrate, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Conferring fame.
E.
कीर्त्ति, and कर what makes.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Said, asserted.
2 Known, notorious.
3 Celebrated, praised.
E.
कृत to celebrate, affix क्त.

mfn. (भाक्)
Celebrated, famous.
m. (-भाक्)
A name of DROṆĀCĀRYA, the military preceptor of the PĀṆḌUS and KURUS.
E.
कीर्त्ति fame, and भाज to serve or honour, affix क्विप्.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Praised, famous, celebrated.
n. (-मान्)
The elder brother of VASUDEVA.
E.
कीर्त्ति, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-षः)
Death, dying.
E.
कीर्त्ति fame, and शेष end.

mfn. (-र्त्त्यः-र्त्त्या-र्त्त्यं)
To be praised or celebrated.
E.
कृत to praise, क्यप aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Covered, bestrewed.
E.
कॄ to scatter, passive form, शानच् aff.
